description: This PHP source file defines a class ListViewDataEmailsSearchOnCrm which extends the abstract class ListViewDataEmailsSearchAbstract, implementing a method 'search' to perform email search operations within the SuiteCRM project. The function handles CRM email querying, filtering, pagination, and rendering logic related to email data associated with CRM records.

classes.name: ListViewDataEmailsSearchOnCrm
classes.description: Class implementing email search functionality on CRM data within SuiteCRM, extending an abstract search class, with the main method 'search' manipulating and retrieving email-related data based on filters, user permissions, and session context.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for emails in the CRM database based on provided filter fields, user request, and context. Handles query construction, data retrieval, pagination, and rendering details, and returns structured search results including pagination info and view data.
